Clue → sentence
🤔 Guessing
Her hands are shaky after coffee. Also when she skips lunch.
→ might
It might be too much coffee.
It might be low blood sugar.
🚫 Almost sure it is NOT
She has no cough. She has no fever.
→ can't + because
It can't be flu because she has no fever.

Clue → sentence
She has no cough and no fever.
Her friends ate the same lunch. They are fine.
Her hands are shaky when she skips breakfast.
She is breathless and sweaty before every exam.
She drinks eight cups of coffee a day.
It might be too much coffee.
It can't be flu.
It might be stress.
It might be low blood sugar.
It can't be food poisoning.
